cells.defectNote: Android WebView on this emulator keeps navigator.onLine=true with zero active networks, so svc-disable alone never delivers the 'offline' event; the banner UI was exercised by dispatching the same DOM event the OS should deliver (real network state verified independently via dumpsys: no default network). Recovery verified symmetrically via the 'online' event (banner cleared). On physical devices the OS signal is expected to fire normally. Filed as emulator/WebView limitation, not an app defect.
